svg.text: fix: retry webhook delivery on 5xx with backoff #52
Fleet: scope, security, db, simplicity, test-quality ran (contract off). 4 findings.

g.text: security · deliver.ts — retry loop re-sent the original signature header after payload mutation
Failure scenario: attempt 2 signs stale body → receiver accepts a payload we no longer sent.
Fix in this branch: re-sign per attempt (deliver.ts, sign.ts).
test-quality · retry.test.ts — the backoff test asserted the mock's schedule, not the behaviour
A broken backoff would still pass. Rewritten against fake timers; goes red if the curve changes.
simplicity · backoff.ts — "config object with one possible value"
Reason: the second value ships in #38 next week; the shape is load-bearing, not speculative.
db · migration — "add an index on (delivery_id, attempted_at)"
Too large for this branch (new index on a hot table). Filed as #44, blocked-by recorded on the board.

svg.text: Every finding answered in writing. No agent gates the merge — CI does. The reviewer reads decisions, not diffs.
